## agent-payment-processor v1.0.2 changelog

Initial release of Paegents Pay skill.

- Enables agents to buy or sell services via Paegents using the published SDK and API.
- Supports registering services, creating usage agreements, bilateral escrow activation, metered usage routing, and recommended settlement workflows.
- Compatible with Claude-Code, OpenClaw, and Cursor; operates on Base and Base-Sepholia networks using USDC stablecoin.
- Emphasizes separation of agreement and activation, client-side signing, and live state authority through activation packages.
- Full guidance provided for both buyer and seller workflows, including state handling and support boundaries.
